name: 4,7-Dimethoxy-5-methyl-2,3-dihydro-1H-inden-2-amine
summary: DOM-AI, also known as 4,7-dimethoxy-5-methyl-2-aminoindane, is a putative serotonergic psychedelic of the 2-aminoindane family and cyclic analogue of DOM. It was first described in the scientific literature by David E. Nichols and colleagues in 1974.
